agent_explanation: No controller work and no walls. Energy flat (~3473 J) through steps 24-27 then nearly doubles to ~6424 J in step 28 when light body 1 collides with heavy fast body 2; body 2 speeds up 19.8->28.9 despite e<1. Removing restitution removes gain, so restitution impulse handling on high-mass-ratio impact injects energy.
